proposalNotes: semantics: element "button" inferred from the set name "Button" — inference is mechanical (name/axis table), review

variant axis "State" (Default|Hover|Focus Visible|Disabled) IS the platform's interaction states, not API — promoted: the axis is NOT a prop; anatomy and base facts come from the 12 default-state variant(s); Hover→hover, Focus Visible→focus-visible propose root state overrides; Disabled→ a `disabled` BOOLEAN prop + disabled state block

Button:root fill: bindings differ across variants without correlating to any variant axis: color.action.primary.background vs color.feedback.success.foreground vs color.action.secondary.background vs color.action.danger.background vs color.action.ghost.background — routed to the mint pass at captured-value literal fidelity (per-variant leaves when it classifies: any single axis, or an axis pair/triple on the root; otherwise the mint pass refuses BY NAME below); the observed refs here are the rename targets

Button:root padding-inline: bindings are a function of variant axis "size" by VALUE (default medium={space.inset-x.md}; small={space.inset-x.sm}, large={space.inset-x.lg}) — carried as tokensByProp overrides (v10; the token names do not spell the axis values, so the substituted-ref shape cannot carry them)

Button:root padding-block: bindings are a function of variant axis "size" by VALUE (default medium={space.inset-y.md}; small={space.inset-y.sm}, large={space.inset-y.lg}) — carried as tokensByProp overrides (v10; the token names do not spell the axis values, so the substituted-ref shape cannot carry them)

Button:root topRightRadius: bindings differ across variants without correlating to any variant axis: radius.control vs control.md
Button:root bottomLeftRadius: bindings differ across variants without correlating to any variant axis: radius.control vs control.md
Button:root bottomRightRadius: bindings differ across variants without correlating to any variant axis: radius.control vs control.md
Button:root: corner radii bindings are not uniform — border-radius not representable, review
Button:root itemSpacing: bindings differ across variants without correlating to any variant axis: space.gap.control vs space.inset-y.lg
Button:root/loadingSpinner: visibility bound to BOOLEAN "Loading" — proposed as prop `loading` (default false: the property definition's defaultValue, dump v1.5)

Button:root/label: typography varies across variants (fontSize 16/14/18, weight Medium) — no single text-style identity adopted (the first variant's value would be wrong for the others); font-size minted per variant where axis-correlated (review)
Button:root: strokeWeight differs in state "focus-visible" with bound variables in play — bound number-channel state inversion is not implemented; NAMED, review

Button:root: state "focus-visible" adds a border the base does not draw — proposed as the focus OUTLINE pair (outline-color/outline-width; the generators' focus boilerplate carries outline-style + offset), review

prop `disabled`: promoted from axis value "State=Disabled" — a BOOLEAN prop (native disabled attribute on interactive elements), bound to design property "Disabled" (the forward generator's spelling; the imported set spelled it as an axis value — rename consequence documented here)

prop `label`: the single text prop carries the component's main content — repo contracts bind main content to code prop "children" (ds.button convention); adopt by setting bindings.code.prop to "children" when this is the label (note-only, nothing renamed mechanically)
